requirements.text: At least three years of experience designing and building LLM evaluations.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating complex evaluations or simulators for RL post-training, such as LLM-as-judge systems, RL environments, or simulations.
A strong research record demonstrated through first-author or co-author publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or equivalent venues, or self-published open-source research of comparable quality.
Production-quality Python skills, including testing, maintainability, and experience supporting regular software releases.
Hands-on experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, and Weights & Biases.
Experience designing original evaluation methods beyond running existing benchmarks.
Ability to communicate research findings clearly and collaborate closely with a small engineering team.
Availability to work onsite in Brooklyn five days per week.
Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a related quantitative field.
Experience building simulated environments or synthetic users to evaluate or train LLMs.
Research or engineering experience involving LLM memory, identity, or personalization.
Familiarity with data pipeline and configuration tools such as Hydra, Kafka, and SQL.
Meaningful contributions to open-source AI research or benchmarks.
